title: telophyllum quadriflorum
intro: Telophyllum quadriflorum, commonly known as Telophyllum, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Telophyllum include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its traditional medicinal use. However, further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents of Telophyllum, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
